_about: Screen x scale x runner. scripts/check-matrix.mjs reads this in CI: every Shot-Panel call in scripts/drive.ps1 must belong to a screen here, and every screen must list both runners and every scale in 'scales'. Add a screen here when you add a panel; CI fails otherwise. 'shots' are the file stems the driver writes (no extension).

blockedScales.200: Windows offers 200% only when the display is at least about 2048x1536; the hosted runners (Windows Server 2025, x64 and ARM64) offer 1920x1080 at most, so 100-175% is the real range (dpi-log.txt in the artifact lists the modes and the scale range). 200% is in TESTING.md as a real-hardware item.

screens.scenario: island pill: clock and focus timer

panelShotsOutsideTheMatrix._why: Shot-Panel names that are variants of a screen above (same window, other state or entry point).
